title: Activation Orchestra: Rolesheet + KPI Synchronizer
content:
Purpose:
This doc is a compact, actionable rolesheet and KPI synchronizer for upcoming activations (internal beta -> limited public). It sits between the product roadmap and the runbook — focused on who does what, measurable acceptance criteria, and the minimum signals we need to give the green light.

Context and scope:
- Launch type: phased feature activation (hosted API + Dedicated early-adopter cohort)
- Target cohort: 50 customers, ~100k monthly tokens per customer average, staggered across 3 waves
- Objective: two-week beta, instrumented KPI window, rollback rules defined

Sprint timeline (high level):
- Week -4: Readiness validation and smoke tests (internal)
- Week -2: Early-adopter onboarding (wave 0), telemetry sanity checks
- Week 0: Wave 1 activation (10 customers), 72h concentrated monitoring
- Week +2: Wave 2 (20 customers) if criteria met
- Week +4: Wave 3 (remaining cohort) or scale pause

Activation lanes and owners (single point per lane):
- Product ops lead: Priya Kapoor — coordination, KPI owner for activation metrics
- SRE / Observability: Evan Zhang — alerting, tracing, dashboards, retention plan
- Serving runtime: Carlos Ruiz — model routing, fallback policy, capacity knobs
- Dedicated infra: Nina Patel — reserved pools, autoscale config, capacity testing
- Developer experience: Liam O'Connor — onboarding templates, SDK checklist, customer-runbook
- Customer success / AE: Sofia Martinez — onboarding cadence, acceptance confirmation

Primary KPIs (synchronizer targets and thresholds):
- API p95 latency (gen): target <= 400ms, soft-threshold 450ms, hard-threshold 600ms (fail open -> rollback)
- Error rate (5xx): target <= 0.2% of requests in 1h window, stop if >1% sustained 30m
- Token throughput per GPU: baseline pilot profile >= 75% of lab benchmark
- Cost/unit delta (hosted vs dedicated): expected <= 15% above projection during pilot
- Customer satisfaction (NPS pulse, onboarding): >= +30 at 7-day pulse
- Quality regressions (eval prompt set): no more than 2% drop in baseline ROUGE/QA score

Readiness checklist (binary items; owner initials):
- Infra smoke pass on representative traffic (load test): Nina P. [ ]
- Canary run 48h with synthetic and recorded traces: Carlos R. [ ]
- Alerting playbook authored and tested (pager to rotation): Evan Z. [ ]
- Onboarding doc + sample SDK script validated by 2 customers: Liam O. [ ]
- Legal & compliance checklist signed for cohort (DPA, region controls): Legal (trigger owner) [ ]
- Telemetry tags enabled (customer_id, feature_flag, model_variant): Priya K. / Evan Z. [ ]
- Eval suite baseline recorded + regression guardrails active: Product QA [ ]
- Rollback and failover routes configured and rehearsed: Carlos R. / Nina P. [ ]
- Customer success kickoff slots reserved: Sofia M. [ ]
- Cost cap alert thresholds configured (per-customer, global): Finance/ProdOps [ ]

Go / No-Go decision rubric (operationalized):
- Soft go: All binary checklist items checked OR documented compensating control for any unchecked item. No KPI is in hard-failure state.
- Hard go: Soft go + zero critical alerts during 24h internal canary and p95 latency below 450ms.
- No-go / rollback trigger: any single hard-threshold breach (e.g., 5xx >1% sustained 30m, data exfiltration concern, or critical infra failure).

Escalation flow (who to call first):
1) Lane owner (see above) -> 2) Product ops lead (Priya) -> 3) SRE lead & oncall -> 4) CTO-level pager if cross-region outage or security incident

Data and dashboards (minimum set):
- Real-time Ops dashboard: p95 latency, 5xx rate, throughput, queue depth (Evan)
- Cost exposure dashboard: rolling 24h predicted spend (Finance/ProdOps)
- Quality monitoring: sample outputs + regression score drift (Product QA)
- Customer signals: onboarding completion %, CS tickets opened, initial NPS pulse (CS)

Quick-run playbook snippets (copy into runbook):
- High error spike: reduce traffic to hosted fallback variant -> scale up dedicated pool -> open incident channel -> start triage template
- Latency degradation: disable batching/adjust concurrency -> re-route high-latency customers -> profile runtime kernels -> rollback to previous model build if needed

Risk register (top 5, mitigations):
- Unexpected quality regression: gate with eval set and quick rollback -> mitigation: hold wave progression until confirmed
- Underprovisioned capacity: conservative autoscale + manual reserve for first 48h -> mitigation: burst pool config
- Cost overrun from test traffic misconfig: cost caps and finance alerting -> mitigation: throttle test traffic
- Onboarding friction: pre-call checklist + SDK snippets + CS templates -> mitigation: dedicate 2 CS engineers first 72h
- Telemetry gaps: mandatory tagging policy and pre-flight validation script -> mitigation: block go without tags

Communications plan (first 72h):
- Hourly updates pushed to #launch-ops during first 8h, then cadence -> every 2h through 72h
- Incident channel naming: #launch-ops-{feature}-{wave}
- Customer-facing incident template: brief, impact, ETA, mitigation steps (owned by CS)

Acceptance handoff (post-wave 1 -> wave 2):
- Confirm KPIs: p95, 5xx, onboard completion, and 7-day NPS pulse within thresholds
- Postmortem checklist: incidents documented, root cause tasks assigned, retrospective scheduled
- Scale decision: product ops presents to leadership with KPI snapshot + retained risk log

Open questions / unknowns:
- Are there any customers in the cohort with special compliance requirements not yet surfaced? (CS -> list)
- Do any early-adopter integrations require longer auth token TTLs? (DevEx -> confirm)
- Is there a contingency for model-specific regressions requiring manual human review? (QA -> plan)

Next immediate actions (0-48h):
- Owners to mark readiness checklist items and add concrete compensation controls if they cannot be satisfied
- Evan to publish dashboard links and short-run alert playbook
- Nina to run final capacity smoke with the pilot traffic script (attach results)
- Priya to schedule the pre-activation check at Week -2 and confirm all stakeholders

Notes / provenance:
- Drafted during cross-functional readiness workshop 2025-11-10. This is an operational artifact intended to be copied into the canonical runbook (confluence:PRODOPS-9942) after signoff.

Attachments to add to runbook: load-test CSVs, canary trace bundles, eval-suite baseline, onboarding playbook PDF, signed DPA snapshot.

Owner sign-off: Priya Kapoor (product-ops) — final signoff required from SRE, Serving Runtime, Legal, and CS prior to Week 0 activation.
